episode_title: Your Ads Aren’t the Problem. Your Product Photos Are.

real_qa.q: What are the three pillars PhotoRoom uses to evaluate product pages in the PhotoRoom 100 methodology?
real_qa.r: The three pillars are product fidelity, which builds trust with accurate details of the item; visual realism, which ensures the image looks like the actual item and appears believable; and gallery complete, which is a gallery that converts by telling you everything you need to know so you don't have to read descriptions or text about the item.
real_qa.requete: PhotoRoom 100 three pillars product page evaluation

real_qa.q: How does PhotoRoom improve AI image generation success rates compared to using frontier models directly?
real_qa.r: PhotoRoom tested 850 images and found the best leading model achieved only 29% success rate. Through their QA loop process, PhotoRoom regenerates failed images to improve the success rate to approximately 40%, then applies another generation cycle to reach approximately 80% total success. PhotoRoom processed over 7 billion images last year, allowing them to learn continuously from these images to provide quality output at scale.
real_qa.requete: PhotoRoom AI image generation success rate vs leading models

real_qa.q: What conversion lift did a Shopify customer achieve after PhotoRoom improved their product page images?
real_qa.r: A Shopify customer who went through PhotoRoom's product page radar evaluation for 25 images and fixed all identified issues saw a 71% gain in add to basket for those specific items, representing a significant lift in overall sales. The customer is now revamping hundreds of items across her total Shopify store based on these results.
real_qa.requete: PhotoRoom Shopify customer 71% add to basket conversion lift

real_qa.q: Why do most eCommerce product pages fail to convert despite high traffic investment?
real_qa.r: Merchants are moving so fast that they neglect to give product pages the importance they deserve. While beautiful images draw people in, they do not necessarily sell the product. Brands need to invest resources—whether time or financial investment in professional studios—to ensure product fidelity, visual realism, and gallery completeness. AI has democratized image creation, but without professional oversight, the quality rarely matches what is needed to convert customers.
real_qa.requete: why product pages fail to convert despite high ad spend

real_qa.q: What does the PhotoRoom product page rater tool do for Shopify brands?
real_qa.r: The PhotoRoom product page rater allows users to input their store or a single item, and PhotoRoom automatically analyzes what the product page is missing and what needs to be done to complete it. It provides a score and specific recommendations such as adding product video, close-up photos, or lifestyle scenes. Users can then click to access PhotoRoom's tool externally to fix the identified issues.
